title: GLIDE: Scalable and Event-Aware Inductive Forecasting over Evolving Logistics Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of order volume at scale-effect hotspots (SEHs), spatially coherent groups of logistics flows that serve as distributed optimization units for real-time many-to-one dispatch, is a prerequisite for efficient order pooling in on-demand food delivery (OFD) platforms such as Meituan. However, real-world logistics networks present unique challenges that render standard spatiotemporal prediction model ineffective. (i) Dynamic Topology: Unlike static road networks, logistics graphs are ephemeral, with hotspot emerging and vanishing continuously; (ii) Scale--Volume Heterogeneity: Graph sizes vary from $10^2$ to $10^4$, while zero-inflated, long-tailed volumes create computational bottlenecks and bias predictions toward inactivity; and (iii) Event-Driven Disruption: Exogenous events (holidays, weather, academic calendars) induce systematic demand shifts that purely data-driven backbones cannot anticipate. translated_title: GLIDE：面向演化物流图的可扩展且事件感知的归纳式预测
translated_abstract: 在美团等按需外卖（OFD）平台中，准确预测规模效应热点（SEH，即作为实时多对一调度分布式优化单元、空间上连贯的物流流群组）的订单量，是实现高效订单合并的前提。然而，现实世界的物流网络呈现出独特的挑战，使标准的时空预测模型失效：（i）动态拓扑：与静态道路网络不同，物流图具有短暂性，热点不断涌现和消失；（ii）规模—数量异质性：图的规模从10²到10⁴不等，而零膨胀、长尾分布的订单量造成计算瓶颈，并使预测偏向不活跃状态；（iii）事件驱动的扰动：外生事件（节假日、天气、校历等）会引发系统性的需求变化，纯数据驱动的骨干网络无法预先感知。
tldr: 本文提出GLIDE框架，针对物流图动态拓扑、规模—数量异质性和事件驱动扰动三大挑战，实现对演化物流网络中规模效应热点订单量的可扩展、事件感知的归纳式预测，支撑外卖平台的高效订单合并。
en_tdlr: GLIDE is a scalable, event-aware inductive forecasting framework for evolving logistics graphs, tackling dynamic topology, scale-volume heterogeneity, and event-driven disruptions to enable accurate order-volume prediction and efficient order pooling in on-demand food delivery platforms.
